text_block_list.text: Heehee! We beat everyone on the bus to camp this year too!

text_block_list.text: Having rivals is so much fun!

text_block_list.text: If they aren't, then I'll just have to keep beating them every year until they do! ♪

text_block_list.text: Thus begins another summer camp with Maruzensky.
